mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic enzymes, increasing probenecid metabolism and reducing its uricosuric efficacy; probenecid may also increase rifampin levels by competing for renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and rifampin efficacy; consider alternative urate-lowering agents or increase probenecid dose if needed; monitor for tuberculosis treatment failure.
